name: David Ashby
bio: David Ashby is a writer and actor, known for Danger 5 (2011), Italian Spiderman (2007) and Hunters (2016).

credits.title: The Fox
credits.overview: An affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancée into the perfect woman.

credits.title: Echo/Back
credits.overview: In a world where time travel spreads as a virus, a fugitive uses 1-5 second time jumps to escape a police raid.

credits.title: FleshEater: Revenge of the Living Dead
credits.overview: A group of college students take a Halloween hayride in the countryside and convince the driver to take them to a secluded area for a night of debauchery. However, the fun turns to terror when a local farmhand unearths a mysterious wooden box that contains an ancient zombie.
